occurrences.source_excerpt: Joint Range of Motion • the distance and direction a joint can move between the flexed position and the extended position • Each specific joint has a normal range of motion that is expressed in degrees. • Devices used for measuring ROM: goniometer, inclinometer • AROM: active range of motion • Patient moves the joint • AROM actively without any assistance • PROM: passive range of motion • PROM • Therapist moves the joint through the range of motion with no effort from the patient
